name: stat
description: One number and what it means. On the site these are the hours-saved figures and the claimed-name counts, each assembled by hand from a display-face number and a caption. The pairing is the unit: a figure without its label is trivia, and the two have a fixed relationship — the number leads, the label follows, and the label never competes.

value.$description: The display face, tabular, and large enough to actually lead — 2.5x the body size is the floor below which a heading is just bold body text.

a11y.note: The number and its label are one thought, so they are one block — a screen reader reaching `6` with no context has been told nothing. Where the figure is approximate the label says so in words; a `~` is not announced.
